selection_reason: The context-preserving empty-text branch is substantially more stable than the drop-all interpretation. This selects the better actual artifact, not a claim of satisfactory geometry or the authors' implementation.

observations.localization: The complete black assembly and white support base were localized automatically; adjacent equipment remains in the retained scene.
observations.generated_reference: The SAM foreground contains a recognizable yellow articulated arm, cables and a dark pedestal; the generated background cabinet is excluded.
observations.coarse: Real volumetric Gaussian structure and view-dependent occlusion are present. The anchor/front resembles an articulated arm, but most unseen directions are rounded, blocky, translucent or speckled.
observations.drop_all_eq7: All eight matched views show severe saturated yellow fog and expanded object support. This refinement is a visual failure and is retained as a negative experiment.
observations.text_only: The front view remains recognizable and sharper than the failed variant. Side/back views still contain yellow slabs or blobs, holes, floaters and incomplete joint geometry. Refinement does not resolve the single-view coarse geometry limitations.
observations.scene_integration: Old equipment is replaced by new 3D Gaussians and nearby objects occlude it. Base contact remains diffuse; previously unobserved floor contains dark/smeared regions. Original scene extrapolation also degrades in novel orbit views.
observations.background: All retained background Gaussian parameters are bitwise unchanged. This does not guarantee unchanged visibility, valid cast shadows or physically consistent relighting.

review_limits: Eight matched scene directions, a twelve-view object contact sheet, the reference and original-path frame151 were visually reviewed; not every rendered frame was visually inspected.
Both complete 350-frame exports and 72-frame orbits passed image/file and decoded video checks.
No edited-scene ground truth exists. Reference fitting MSE and fixed-background metrics do not establish perceptual quality.
Two unconditional-conditioning interpretations test an unpublished implementation detail, not two different papers.
outcome: Complete reproducible execution with a partially successful structural replacement and substantial multiview quality limitations.
